**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

The agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, minimum fee on termination, or early-termination charge, which satisfies our preferred LD position outright (not merely the fallback):

- **§11 Fees (p0084):** Sparkling's only payment obligation is the fees set out in the Fee Schedule.
- **§17(b) (p0118):** Sparkling's 90-day convenience termination right carries no exit fee, no accelerated or minimum fees — only cessation of use and a destruction/return certification.
- **§17(c) (p0128):** On termination for Garman's default, the licence converts to perpetual with no further fees and Garman must refund fees paid for services not rendered — value flows to us.
- **§8 (p0057):** On rejection of the Software, Garman repays all amounts to Sparkling.
- **§15 (p0105):** Mutual direct-damages/consequential-damages allocation only; no stipulated or pre-agreed sums against Sparkling.

The only Sparkling-facing charge is repair services at Fee Schedule rates for Sparkling-caused faults (§10(c), p0077) — a time-and-materials service charge, not a liquidated amount or penalty, so it is outside this rule. No walk-away exposure exists.
